mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Career Development Plan' and 'Career perspectives and employability'
mappings.mapping_description: The concept directly addresses increased research and transferable skills: the Career Development Plan enumerates seven transferable-skill strands (research integrity; open science and FAIR practice; generative-AI literacy; grant writing; IP and exploitation; project management; science communication), and the employability section states the competence gap the fellowship closes — rigorous predictive modelling and validation across time, sensing scales and environments — with the stated progression to an independent Agricultural Data Scientist specialised in plant stress, Earth observation and decision support.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge' and 'Non-academic placement'
mappings.mapping_description: New mind-sets through international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary experience: international mobility Bulgaria->Hungary with a Hungary-Bulgaria continuation route (Krumatic in-action, MVCRI post-MSCA); inter-sectoral exposure via the M25-M30 AgroVIR placement and the Krumatic development seat; interdisciplinary two-way transfer between plant physiology/horticulture and modelling/EO/data science across ATK, ELTE and MATE.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.mapping_description: Networking and communication with peers and the public: P1-P2 peer-reviewed submissions (third paper possible), conference presentations and seminars; public engagement via practitioner demonstrations, Krumatic-supported Bulgarian farmer demonstrations, one public field demonstration and one public-facing article per year, and the possible Szentendre public demonstration; science communication is a transferable-skill strand of the CDP.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For participating organisations; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Alignment of working conditions with the European Charter for Researchers'
mappings.mapping_description: Charter alignment evidenced at instrument level by the Career Development Plan (D1.3) and the documented supervision and training arrangements. The term 'European Charter for Researchers' appears verbatim. No institutional HR award is claimed for ATK (unverified-accreditation prohibition).

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For participating organisations; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.mapping_description: Quality and sustainability of research training and supervision: defined cadence (weekly one-to-one with the supervisor, co-supervisor technical sessions through the EO strand, monthly progress record, quarterly CDP reviews, monthly face-to-face placement reviews in M25-M30), a Project Steering Group with go/no-go verdicts at the milestone months M6/M14/M18/M24 plus the M27 mid-placement review, and explicit decision-rights and office-based conflict-resolution structures.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For participating organisations; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.mapping_description: Attractiveness, visibility and reputation of the participating organisations: ATK's readiness rests on its funded-MSCA hosting record (LANDRACES 752453) and current Horizon participations; ELTE's instrument environment, MATE's archive, AgroVIR's operational environment and Krumatic's uptake channel each carry a named capacity record in consortium/capabilities.json.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For participating organisations; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.tier3_evidence_ref: training_and_career_development.md — 'Supervision, training and two-way transfer of knowledge'
mappings.mapping_description: R&I capacity and knowledge transfer among participating organisations: documented bidirectional transfer (Fellow->hosts: plant physiology, horticultural crop science, water-stress experimentation, physiological phenotyping, proximal spectral interpretation, the DrR concept; hosts->Fellow: agricultural data science, robust modelling, uncertainty, hyperspectral/UAV/EO integration, research-to-software translation), producing an academic-research-industry knowledge chain across ATK, ELTE, MATE, Krumatic and AgroVIR.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For participating organisations; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.mapping_description: Feedback of research results into teaching: short guest lectures, seminars and practical sessions at MATE and, where institutionally possible, the Agricultural University of Plovdiv, transferring the fellow's five years of university teaching into precision agriculture, EO and agricultural data science — a concrete route despite the host being a research organisation.
